name: Zillah
overview: Zillah is identified in Scripture as one of the two wives of Lamech, highlighting the early biblical record of family and lineage (Genesis 4:19). She is notably the mother of Tubalcain, described as an instructor of every craftsman in brass and iron, indicating a contribution to the development of skilled labor (Genesis 4:22). Lamech’s address to both wives, Adah and Zillah, in a context of personal defense, underscores the family dynamics and the seriousness of his declarations (Genesis 4:23). Together, these verses provide a glimpse into the roles and relationships within Lamech’s household.
